newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange on Monday. No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, Ohio (Shawneetown), this week, bid at 110 percent of tariff, no offer or comparsion.
- Two barges, Mississippi (Oceola through Cairo), next week, bid at 92.5 percent of tarrif, offered at 100 percent of tariff, no comparison.
- Two barges, Mississippi (St. Louis) this, no bid, offered 5 points higher at 110 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, lower Ohio, next week, bid at 110 percent of tariff, offered at 115 percent of tariff, no comparison.
- One barge, Illinois (Hennepin), on station, bid at 185 percent of tariff, no offer or comparsion.
- Two barges, Illinois, one each weeks of February 16 and 23, bid at 150 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
